plugins.name: cgh
plugins.description: The context graph hub: memory, plans and knowledge shared across sessions and agents, plus 62 MCP tools for code navigation (symbol lookup, call graph, imports, docs). Tool execution is server-side, so responses cost near-zero model tokens. Requires the cgh binary on PATH.
